title: Attendance and chronic absenteeism
source: NYC Department of Education (NYC Public Schools), End-of-Year Attendance and Chronic Absenteeism Data, school level

attendance_rate.label: Attendance rate
attendance_rate.definition: Total days present divided by total days on register for all students at the school over the school year (all grades, including Pre-K where offered).
attendance_rate.source_field: '% Attendance' (sheet 'All Students', Grade = 'All Grades', Category = 'All Students', Year = '2024-25')

chronic_absent.label: Chronically absent
chronic_absent.definition: Share of students with attendance of 90 percent or less (absent 10 percent or more of their days). Students must be enrolled at least 10 days and present at least 1 day to be counted.
chronic_absent.source_field: '% Chronically Absent' (sheet 'All Students', Grade = 'All Grades', Category = 'All Students', Year = '2024-25')

chronic_absent_prev.label: Chronically absent, 2023-24
chronic_absent_prev.definition: Same measure for the prior school year, 2023-24, from the same file.
chronic_absent_prev.source_field: '% Chronically Absent' (sheet 'All Students', Grade = 'All Grades', Category = 'All Students', Year = '2023-24')

students_counted.label: Students counted
students_counted.definition: Number of students enrolled at least 10 days and present at least 1 day, the denominator for the chronic absence rate.
students_counted.source_field: '# Contributing 10+ Total Days and 1+ Pres Day' (sheet 'All Students', Grade = 'All Grades', Category = 'All Students', Year = '2024-25')

notes: Citywide reference (citywide file, All Grades, All Students): chronic absence 33.3% and attendance 89.8% in 2024-25; chronic absence 34.8% and attendance 89.6% in 2023-24. Citywide counts each student once, so it will not equal an average of school rates.
Median school-level chronic absence across the 1559 schools with a value: 36.6%.

Suppression marker: 's' (FERPA: rows with five or fewer students or 900 or fewer total days, plus complementary suppression; chronic absence also suppressed when five or fewer students contribute at least 20 days). Stored as null.

Coverage per the DOE file notes: Districts 1-32 and 75. Charter schools, District 79 programs, home schooling and home/hospital instruction are excluded. Transfer schools are removed from the school-level file. Charter DBNs (84xxxx) will therefore have no attendance values.
chronic_absent_prev is null where the school has no 2023-24 row or the 2023-24 value was suppressed.
5 DBNs have a 2023-24 row but no 2024-25 row (closed, merged or renumbered); they are omitted.
Attendance is attributed to the school the student attended at the time; a student enrolled at two schools in a year counts at both.
Percent columns in the source are 0-100 with full float precision; stored here divided by 100 and rounded to 4 decimals.

Raw school file is 88 MB and is not committed. It is downloaded from file_url; the build script caches it at /var/folders/50/ct9y6k7s19l4swcw8vf7xprw0000gn/T/nyc-schools-atlas-sources/public-school-attendance-results-2019-2025.xlsx.
